name: TMUA (Test of Mathematics for University Admission)
description: Admissions test required for Computer Science and Economics courses at Cambridge, Imperial, and other elite UK universities.

name: ESAT (Engineering and Physical Sciences Admissions Test)
description: Admissions test required for Engineering, Physics, and Natural Sciences at Cambridge and Imperial College London.

name: SAT Exam (October Session)
description: Standardized test widely used for college admissions in the United States and global private institutions.

name: SAT Exam (December Session)
description: Digital SAT session, often the final chance for regular decision admissions deadlines.

name: ACT Exam (October Session)
description: Standardized US college admissions test measuring English, math, reading, and science reasoning.

name: AP Exams Registration Deadline
description: Final registration deadline to take Advanced Placement exams through the College Board in May.

name: JEE Main (Session 1)
description: Joint Entrance Examination (Main) registration deadline for the January Session engineering admissions.

name: JEE Main (Session 2)
description: Registration deadline for JEE Main April session.

name: CUET UG (Common University Entrance Test)
description: Compulsory common entrance test for undergraduate admissions across central universities in India (including DU).
